package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// CourseModuleRepoPG implements CourseModuleRepository.
type CourseModuleRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r CourseModuleRepoPG) ReplaceByCourse(ctx context.Context, courseID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM course_module WHERE course_id=$1`, courseID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, item := range items {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO course_module (course_id, module_id, "order", status) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,1) ON CONFLICT (course_id, module_id) DO UPDATE SET "order"=EXCLUDED."order", status=EXCLUDED.status`,
			courseID, item.ChildID, item.Order); err != nil {
			return mapPgError(err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (r CourseModuleRepoPG) Add(ctx context.Context, courseID string, moduleID string, order int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO course_module (course_id, module_id, "order", status) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,1) ON CONFLICT (course_id, module_id) DO UPDATE SET "order"=EXCLUDED."order", status=EXCLUDED.status`,
		courseID, moduleID, order)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

func (r CourseModuleRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, courseID string, moduleID string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM course_module WHERE course_id=$1 AND module_id=$2`, courseID, moduleID)
	return err
}

var _ repository.CourseModuleRepository = (*CourseModuleRepoPG)(nil)
